liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Scarlet starts tentatively, and the jam opens with an odd synth solo from Brent; Relaxed, laid-back Scarlet>Fire wanders in many directions and lets the band gel; Bobby is strong, Jerry's closing solo interesting [10][11][13]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Stagger Lee is among the longest and most interesting versions ever [17]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Very relaxed playing makes for a nice Fire, and Not Fade Away is perfect [16]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Vocals are nice though not crackling; Jerry seems to guide Brent through his solos [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-06-28.179020.sbd.miller.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 189 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1979-06-28.179137.sbd.patched.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 22 songs; 191 min [2]
- **gd1979-06-28.179136.sbd.patched.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 22 songs; 191 min [3]
- **gd1979-06-28.178893.akg.d224e.hollwein.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 187 min [5]. Said about its sound: Minor noise anomalies present in shnid 11159 are absent from this transcription; pitch correction was applied [5]
- **gd79-06-28.hollwein.munder.11159.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 176 min; rated 3.33/5 by 6 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds sweet, according to the reviewer; Audience recording is not the best; Audience recording is decent [14][15][19]
- **gd79-06-28.sbd.set2.jools.19514.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 92 min; rated 3.4/5 by 5 [9]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is not especially crisp; Soundboard sounds washed out and slightly warbled, drums iffy, like an early matrix-style mix; Soundboard is shaky and incomplete, but still a good listen [10][13][18]

## Around the show

- Band returning after a six-week layoff; the rust shows [10]
- Reviewer contrasts Brent's idea-introducing playing with Keith, whose playing mirrored the band, after hearing a Spring 1990 set [15]
- Second half of 1979 is great, starting with this show [16]
- Reviewer prefers the audience recording to the board recording [17]
- Reviewer says Keith declined into a zombie-like state from drug use, while Brent channeled his into intense playing [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-06-28.179020.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Mastering by Charlie Miller  August 12, 2026; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) > WAV (24-bit/96k) [1]. Also: Dolby decoding was fine-tuned with DDi Codec; patch credited to Reinhardt Hollwein, Bob Menke and Scott Clugston [1]
- **gd1979-06-28.179137.sbd.patched.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 8, 2026; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) > WAV (24-bit/96k) [2]. Also: Patched version of shnid 178999, Dolby decoding tuned with DDi Codec; this is the 2496 transfer reduced to 16-bit/48k [2]
- **gd1979-06-28.179136.sbd.patched.miller.flac2496**: transferred by All Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 8, 2026; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) > WAV (24-bit/96k) [3]. Also: Patched version of shnid 178999, Dolby decoding tuned with DDi Codec; patch by Hollwein, Menke and Clugston [3]
- **gd1979-06-28.178893.akg.d224e.hollwein.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Reinhart Hohlwein; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Reinhardt Hollwein's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG D224E mics > Sony 158 (Maxell UDXL-II 90) [5]. Also: Menke's Nakamichi 700 source and Miller's soundboard supply an 11-second patch in Drums [5]
- **gd79-06-28.hollwein.munder.11159.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Reinhardt Hollwein; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM? [7]
- **gd79-06-28.sbd.set2.jools.19514.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]
